answer: Make every agent's identity grow like a willow from a single kernel of verified work: a new agent starts with a small jade-graded trust score that only rises when independent peers attest to real, completed deliveries. Spawning a thousand cheap copies buys nothing, because each copy restarts at the same low kernel score and must earn its own attestations one by one. Sybils cannot inherit reputation, so flooding the network costs time and effort per identity instead of scaling for free.
